title: Moldova’s unique back door into Europe
snippet: Moldova’s goal to become an EU member state by 2030 possesses a unique alternative option. A political union with neighbouring Romania would allow the country to bypass the process of accession. The distinct outlook of governments amidst the rise of the right across the EU may ultimately decide the means by which Moldova becomes a part of the bloc.
